headline: Referred an Open Meeting Law complaint over an earlier committee meeting to the city solicitor for a written response.
summary: The committee heard a complaint under the Open Meeting Law about its July 9 meeting. Members voted 4-0 to refer the complaint to the city solicitor for a written response.
decisions: Referred the Open Meeting Law complaint about the July 9, 2026 meeting to the city solicitor for a written response, 4-0.

# City of Salem, Massachusetts

"Know Your Rights Under the Open Meeting Law, M.G.L. c. 30A ss. 18-25 and City Ordinance Sections 2-2028 through 2-2033."

The City Council Committee on Government Services met in the Council Chamber on July 16, 2026 at 6:00 PM for the purpose of discussing the matters(s) listed below. Notice of this meeting was posted on July 13, 2026 at 4:27 P.M.

(This meeting is being recorded)

## ATTENDANCE

ABSENT WERE: Councilor Vanda

## SUBJECT(S)

Open Meeting Law Complaint for the Government Services Committee Meeting held on July 9, 2026.

- Read complaint aloud
- Motion by Councilor Sydnick to refer to city solicitor for written response
- Second by Councilor Flynn All in favor 4-0
- Motion by Councilor Sydnick to adjourn
- Second by Councilor Flynn All in favor 4-0

Mtg adjourned 6:06 pm

On the motion of C.

the meeting adjourned at 6:06 P.M.

[signature]

(Chairperson)
